sources.snippet: Overview Carnice-9b is a 9-billion parameter language model built by kai-os and fine-tuned specifically for the Hermes Agent runtime environment. The model is based on Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B but underwent specialized training focused on agentic tasks rather than generic chat quality.
